corpus.coverageNotes: Targeted topic scan of official Paper 1 PDFs for 2 April 2026 shifts 1 and 2 and 4 April 2026 shift 1 (225 questions total). priority.rationale: Two directly relevant verified recent JEE Main questions in the scanned corpus, current syllabus inclusion, a common conceptual distinction, and a short visual route from a prerequisite to a real exam question. Prioritised for this first trial batch; no invented frequency or marks-percentage claim.

pyqs.locator: JEE Main Paper 1; 02 April 2026, Shift 1; Q42; question ID 69112142; PDF page 17
pyqs.independentSolution: E=φ+3eV0; E/2=φ+eV0. Subtraction gives E=4eV0, φ=eV0.

pyqs.locator: JEE Main Paper 1; 04 April 2026, Shift 1; Q32; question ID 695278257; PDF page 11
pyqs.independentSolution: φ=hν0, so the lowest threshold frequency gives the smallest work function and largest Kmax for equal incident photon energy.

verificationNotes: The graph question is paraphrased into threshold frequencies, with illumination above all three thresholds stated explicitly. No emission is shown below the work function; negative kinetic energy is never displayed.
